controls.negative: Probe against patched/app.py exits 1 (marker NOT observed).

description: DocuFind is a small internal document-search service. Its /search endpoint reflects the user's query into the results page ('You searched for: ...') without HTML escaping, so markup supplied in the q parameter is returned verbatim in the HTML response. The patched variant HTML-escapes the reflected query; routes, data, and all other behavior are identical.

expected_finding.evidence: The probe submits a unique script payload as q; against the vulnerable app the exact payload bytes appear unescaped in the response body, while the patched app returns only the HTML-escaped form, so the verbatim payload never appears.

title: Reflected XSS in document search
